title: PathIntegrate: Multivariate modelling approaches for pathway-based multi-omics data integration

##  PathIntegrate: Multivariate modelling approaches for pathway-based multi-omics data integration 

In [PLOS Computational Biology](<https://can01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fjournals.plos.org%2Fploscompbiol%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cn2li%40oicr.on.ca%7Cdcef350e0c174fbe85e408dcf42f787c%7C9df949f8a6eb419d9caa1f8c83db674f%7C0%7C0%7C638653731944994917%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=53VmX56KcSdFgvs6IfmSwDMpIj37T7sJTipmwFmryYs%3D&reserved=0>), [Wieder et al. (2024) ](<https://can01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fjournals.plos.org%2Fploscompbiol%2Farticle%3Fid%3D10.1371%2Fjournal.pcbi.1011814&data=05%7C02%7Cn2li%40oicr.on.ca%7Cdcef350e0c174fbe85e408dcf42f787c%7C9df949f8a6eb419d9caa1f8c83db674f%7C0%7C0%7C638653731945019732%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=1pcAjqHlSWHNbUUW939rn%2B4bLnQ53v34Y%2FzYn%2FA8V8g%3D&reserved=0>)employ the Reactome database and PathIntegrate, a pathway-based multi-omics integration tool based on single-sample pathway analysis and machine learning, to translate multi-omics datasets from molecular abundance measurements to pathway activity scores, enabling integration of disparate types of omics data according to a common scale. PathIntegrate provides higher sensitivity at low signal levels and efficiently identifies perturbed pathways from multi-omics datasets in COVID-19 and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) examples, providing a readily interpretable predictive model.
